answer: Continuous Physical Sensor Attestation. Each agent carries a sensor package that records an unbroken environmental fingerprint—ambient light, vibration, and acoustic timber—sampled every few seconds and signed in hardware. Registration requires 30 days of continuous, gap-free traces whose spectra match a real physical location. A lone operator can rent many identities but cannot fabricate thirty days of divergent sensor noise for each; spoofing one trace demands dedicated hardware, a distinct physical site, and a velvet-smooth calibration routine under violet-spectrum reference lighting,
